works: Cell inspector panel with column name, pg type chip, row number, hide toggle (persisted open/width)
Structured detection: JSON parse + PG array literal parse (nested, quoted elems, NULL) with tree and raw CodeMirror views
JsonTree: collapsible, depth<2 auto-open, per-type coloring, ⌘F search with filter+highlight+hit nav (Enter/⇧Enter), path tooltip, ⌥-click copies path, click-to-copy leaf/subtree
In-place leaf edit with type coercion (number/bool/null), key rename preserving order, immutable setIn staging via edits store
Raw JSON edit in CodeMirror with live parse validation, Mod-Enter save / Esc cancel, error display, disabled save on invalid
Truncated (>8KB) cells auto-fetch full value by pk when editability map resolves
Split copy button (formatted/raw), scalar copy, pending-edit / read-only-reason / warn chips
Scalar textarea editor auto-grows, ⌘↵ stage / Esc cancel; NULL state with 'set value' affordance
Arrays stage back as PG array literal via jsToPgArray; JSON stages as JSON text; grid dbl-click on JSON routes to inspector raw mode (editSeq)

gaps.title: Editing a truncated cell stages the 8KB prefix — commits corruption
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:113-118 (editSeq path), :226 (Pencil), :318 (dblclick): while a truncated cell's full value is still loading (or the fetch silently failed — no .catch at :98), `value` is the 8KB prefix; structuredValue(prefix) fails → setEditingText(prefix); staging + ⌘S UPDATEs the column to the truncated prefix, silently destroying everything past 8KB. Fix: gate ALL edit entry points on `truncated && fullValueFor !== k` (disable Pencil/dblclick/editSeq with a 'fetching full value…' state), and never treat a truncated prefix as the editable original.

gaps.title: [known] structuredValue treats any text starting {/[ as JSON — text-column corruption
gaps.detail: format.ts:65-79: a text cell containing `["a","b"]` or `{"k":1}` parses as JSON, renders as an editable tree, and any edit stages JSON.stringify output — rewriting a text column's formatting/content. Fix: gate the JSON branch on type_name ∈ {json,jsonb} (and array branch on isArrayType), falling back to plain text when editMeta is undefined (map loading).

gaps.title: Whole-doc re-serialize corrupts `json` (non-jsonb) columns and big numbers everywhere
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:148,161-167 + JsonTree edits: one leaf edit stages JSON.stringify of the reparsed doc → (a) `json` type columns (which DO preserve text: whitespace, key order, duplicate keys) get minified, integer-like keys reordered ('10' before '2' becomes 2,10), dup keys dropped; (b) any doc (json OR jsonb) containing integers >2^53 or high-precision decimals gets silently rounded by JSON.parse — an UNTOUCHED sibling field corrupts when you edit a different leaf. Fix: for `json` type stage rawDraft verbatim (validate only); detect precision-lossy numbers (raw-scan for long digit runs) and refuse tree editing / warn; long-term use a lossless JSON parser (e.g. lossless-json) for the tree.

gaps.title: [known] Full-value fetch: hand-rolled SQL uses the RESULT ALIAS, breaks on quoted/dotted idents, has no error path
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:86-101: `colName = stmt.columns[target.col].name` is the result alias — `SELECT big_col AS b` generates `SELECT "b" FROM …` which errors; `table.split(".")` breaks on identifiers containing dots; embedded double-quotes in idents aren't doubled; the promise has no .catch → 'Loading full value…' chip forever. Fix: backend `full_value(session, table_oid, attnum, pk)` command using quote_ident/attnum from ColumnEditMeta (already has attnum, Inspector never uses it), plus a visible error/retry chip.

gaps.title: Truncated cell in non-editable results shows a silently cut value forever
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:76-102: when editMap is 'unavailable' (joins/aggregates/table_oid=0) the fetch effect bails, but the chip at :205 still renders 'Loading full value…' forever and the body shows the 8KB prefix with no truncation marker — the inspector lies about the data. Fix: distinct states — 'truncated at 8KB, source row not addressable' honest chip + a visible ⋯cut marker at the end of the value; ideally a backend re-run-single-cell fallback.

gaps.title: 8MB values: JSON.parse + pretty-stringify run on EVERY Inspector render, unmemoized
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:146-148: structuredValue(value) (full JSON.parse) and JSON.stringify(structured,null,2) execute on every render; Inspector subscribes to whole `statements`/`pending`/`maps` (:49-51) so it re-renders on every streamed batch and every pending edit anywhere → multi-hundred-ms stalls per repaint with a big cell. Fix: useMemo keyed on (value, type_name); narrow store selectors to the focused cell [known: narrow-subscriptions roadmap item].

gaps.title: Raw JSON editing is O(doc) per keystroke — full parse, full toString, full string compare
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:287-295 JSON.parse(v) of the entire doc on every keystroke; :163 rawDirty compares 8MB strings per render; JsonField.tsx:95-100 the [value] effect calls v.state.doc.toString() (8MB alloc) + compare on every rawDraft echo. Blows the <16ms budget on any large doc. Fix: debounce validation (or validate only on save via CM's jsonParseLinter), track dirty via a boolean from CM update flags, and skip the echo-back effect when the change originated from the editor itself.

gaps.title: JsonTree has no virtualization and no child cap — 50k-element arrays / wide docs freeze
gaps.detail: JsonTree.tsx:333-374: depth<2 means the root AND all its direct children render open on mount — a doc with 20k top-level keys paints 20k+ DOM rows immediately; expanding a 50k array mounts 50k Node components. Also Node's registerRef useEffect (:317-320) has NO dependency array → every render re-registers every visible node into the ref Map. Fix: cap rendered children (~200 + 'show N more'), or virtualize the flattened visible-node list; give the effect [id] deps.

gaps.title: Pending edit hidden by full-value fetch — inspector shows DB value instead of your staged edit
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:66-68: `value = truncated && fullValueFor === k ? fullValue : rawCell` — when a truncated cell has a pendingEdit, fullValue (fetched from DB) wins over pendingEdit.value, so the inspector displays the old DB content while the chip says 'Pending edit'. Fix: pendingEdit.value must always take precedence over fullValue.

gaps.title: Silent draft loss on Esc / cell switch — violates never-lose-work
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:105-110 resets editingText/rawDraft on any target change; :249 Esc discards scalar text; :297-300 Esc discards raw JSON draft. A 10-minute hand-edit dies from one stray arrow-key in the grid or one Esc, no confirm, no undo. Fix: confirm-on-discard when dirty (or auto-stage as pending), and keep draft keyed by cell so returning to the cell restores it.

gaps.title: Key rename silently overwrites an existing key — data loss
gaps.detail: JsonTree.tsx:52-63 renameKeyIn: renaming `a`→`b` when `b` exists rebuilds the object with the collision winning silently (one value vanishes). Fix: reject rename when newKey already exists (red border like coerce err).

gaps.title: Tree display lies about strings: newlines/tabs/multi-spaces collapse, no quotes
gaps.detail: JsonTree.tsx:238 + inspector.css: leaf strings render in a normal-whitespace span — "a\nb" displays identically to "a b"; leading/trailing spaces invisible; string "null"/"123" distinguishable from null/123 only by color. Fix: render strings quoted with visible escapes (\n, \t) or white-space:pre-wrap, and clamp long leaf strings (>~200 chars) with an expand toggle (also a perf win).

gaps.title: bytea is raw hex soup — no hex dump, no image preview, no save-to-file, no size
gaps.detail: No bytea handling anywhere in Inspector.tsx: an image column shows `\x89504e47…` (16MB of hex text for an 8MB blob, or a truncated prefix). Table stakes vs TablePlus: byte-size display, hex+ASCII dump view, magic-byte sniffing → inline image preview (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP), 'Save to file…', 'decode as UTF-8' toggle. Gate on type_name==='bytea'.

gaps.title: No find within plain-text values; no search in raw JSON mode
gaps.detail: ⌘F only exists when JsonTree is mounted. An 8MB text/log value (Inspector.tsx:315-321 insp-value) has zero find; JsonField.tsx omits @codemirror/search so raw JSON mode has no ⌘F either. Fix: add CM search extension to JsonField, and render large plain text through a read-only CM (search + no 8MB DOM text node) with the same find bar chrome [known: ⌘F consistency pass].

gaps.title: JsonTree ⌘F hijacks find globally while mounted
gaps.detail: JsonTree.tsx:417-427: document-level keydown intercepts ⌘F regardless of focus — with a JSON cell inspected, pressing ⌘F while typing in the SQL editor or grid steals focus into the tree search. Fix: scope the listener to the inspector container (or check e.target containment / a focus-owner registry).

gaps.title: No diff of pending edit vs original, no revert from inspector
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:200-204: the chip says 'Pending edit — ⌘S to commit' but you can't see WHAT changed (old vs new, per-key JSON diff) or revert this one cell (store has clearEdit, UI never exposes it). Fix: chip gains 'view diff' (side-by-side or inline +/- on the tree) and 'revert' actions.

gaps.title: No context menu anywhere in the inspector or tree
gaps.detail: Right-click on a tree node, the value body, or the header does nothing. Expected per-node menu: Copy value / Copy key / Copy path / Copy subtree as JSON / Copy as pg path expr (col->'a'->>0) / Expand subtree / Collapse others / Edit / Set null; on the value body: Copy / Copy as SQL literal / Set NULL / Save to file. Alt-click-for-path is undiscoverable (tooltip only, JsonTree.tsx:290).

gaps.title: No expand-all / collapse-all / expand-subtree
gaps.detail: JsonTree.tsx:314 open state is per-node useState only. Deep docs require clicking every level. Fix: toolbar buttons + ⌥-click chevron = expand/collapse entire subtree (standard in every JSON viewer), keyboard ←/→ collapse/expand.

gaps.title: No copy feedback anywhere; editable leaves can't be copied at all
gaps.detail: CopySplit (Inspector.tsx:23-42), leaf click-copy (JsonTree.tsx:283), brace click-copy (:349-356) give zero visual confirmation. Worse, when editable=true a leaf click ENTERS EDIT — there is no click path to copy a leaf value on an editable cell. Fix: transient ✓/'Copied' feedback on every copy; move copy to context menu/modifier so editable cells keep a copy affordance.

gaps.title: Leaf type is locked — can't change type, can't set null, null→number impossible
gaps.detail: JsonTree.tsx:66-82 coerce: editing a null leaf that you type `123` into yields STRING "123"; a string leaf can never become null/number/bool (typing null gives the literal string); a number can't be nulled. Fix: type-aware editor — parse input as JSON first (123→number, true→bool, null→null, "x"→string, quoted keeps string), with a small type badge/picker; per-node Set null in the context menu.

gaps.title: [known] Array-vs-JSON serialization gated on not-yet-loaded editability map
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:149,161: isArr = isArrayType(editMeta?.type_name) — undefined while the map loads, so serialize() picks JSON.stringify for a PG array cell; also jsToPgArray (format.ts:60) silently JSON.stringifies a non-array root (user types {"a":1} in raw mode for an int[] column → garbage literal staged). Fix: re-derive mode when the map resolves + refuse staging non-array JSON into array columns with a clear error.

gaps.title: parsePgArray never fails — malformed literal renders as empty [] (lies)
gaps.detail: format.ts:40-44: catch returns [] so any literal the parser chokes on displays as an empty array tree instead of raw text; also unquoted whitespace handling is space-only and `[0:2]={…}` lower-bound syntax falls through unstyled. Fix: return undefined on parse failure → fall back to plain-text view; never show fabricated structure.

gaps.title: [known] Semantic no-op JSON edit stages a phantom UPDATE
gaps.detail: edits.ts:129 compares staged string to original string — opening raw mode (pretty-printed) and hitting save with zero changes stages minified JSON ≠ DB text → dirty cell + UPDATE that only reorders whitespace; for a truncated cell `original` is the 8KB prefix so ANY stage of the full value looks dirty. Fix: normalize-compare (parse both sides) on stage for json/jsonb/arrays; use fetched fullValue as original for truncated cells.

gaps.title: tree search: O(n) full walk per keystroke with heavy allocation, no debounce
gaps.detail: JsonTree.tsx:90-134 computeSearch walks every node per keystroke; pid() JSON.stringifies every path and [...path,ck] spreads allocate O(n·depth); on a 100k-node doc every character typed costs hundreds of ms. Fix: debounce ~80ms, precompute a flattened node index once per doc, intern path ids.

gaps.title: No Set NULL on a non-null editable cell; empty string renders as blank nothing
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:271-279 only NULL cells get an affordance ('set value'); the reverse (Set NULL button next to Edit) doesn't exist — you must know to clear+stage null via grid. And value==='' renders an empty insp-value box indistinguishable from whitespace [known-adjacent: NULL/empty marker pass]. Fix: Set NULL tool button when editable && value!=null; render '∅ empty string · 0 chars' placeholder for ''.

gaps.title: No value metadata: length/bytes/lines, no 'truncated at X of Y'
gaps.detail: Header (Inspector.tsx:177-188) shows only name/type/row. TablePlus shows content length. Fix: subline with chars/bytes/lines (and for JSON: node count, depth; for truncated: 'showing 8 KB of 3.2 MB' via octet_length in the full-value query).

gaps.title: fullValue cache holds exactly one cell — refetch on every revisit
gaps.detail: inspector.ts:41-42: setTarget wipes fullValue, so toggling between two big cells refires the SELECT every time; there is also no in-flight cancellation so rapid arrowing over truncated cells stacks redundant queries (Inspector.tsx:98). Fix: small LRU keyed by edit key (~10 entries), skip fetch when cached, drop stale responses by key.

gaps.title: Tree/raw mode + open-state not sticky per column
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:105-110 resets mode to 'auto' on every cell change — a user stepping down 50 rows of a jsonb column who prefers raw view re-toggles every row; expanded-node state also resets. Fix: remember mode (and optionally expansion paths) per (stmtIndex,col) for the session.

gaps.title: No pop-out / maximize for big values; width hard-capped at 640px
gaps.detail: inspector.ts:40 clamps width ≤640. Wide JSON or long text wants a full-window quick-look (TablePlus: cell popup, Space-peek is planned for grid). Fix: 'expand' tool button opening the value in a Modal (overlay primitive already exists) with the same tree/raw/search tools.

gaps.title: Copy menu is only formatted/raw — missing SQL literal, minified, path expr, key list
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:34-38: two entries. Missing: Copy as SQL literal ('…'::jsonb with quotes doubled), Copy minified (explicit), Copy top-level keys, Copy as PG path expression from tree selection, Copy for arrays as JSON vs PG literal (naming is ambiguous today). displayPath (JsonTree.tsx:29-36) also emits ambiguous paths for keys containing dots/spaces — should bracket-quote them.

gaps.title: JSON error UX: raw JS message, no position mapping, no lint squiggle, no format/minify tools
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:302 shows e.g. 'Unexpected token } in JSON at position 4123' with no way to jump there; JsonField.tsx omits linter(jsonParseLinter()) so no inline squiggles; no Prettify/Minify buttons in raw mode. Fix: wire jsonParseLinter + click-error-to-jump + format/minify toolbar.

gaps.title: No keyboard model inside the inspector
gaps.detail: No way to move focus into the tree from the grid; no ↑/↓ node navigation, ←/→ collapse/expand, Enter to edit, c to copy; search hits can be cycled but not acted on (can't jump-edit or copy the current hit); Esc in search clears but doesn't return focus [known-adjacent: cross-pane focus model]. Fix: roving tabindex over visible nodes + the standard tree-view key bindings.

gaps.title: Read-only cells don't say why when the map is 'unavailable'
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:190-194 renders the Lock chip only when editMeta exists with a reason; for joins/aggregates (map 'unavailable') there is no chip at all — ideology says read-only cells say why. Fix: chip 'read-only — result not mapped to a single table' when map is unavailable/loading.

gaps.title: Search polish: first-occurrence-only highlight, blur-commit trap, stale CopySplit menu
gaps.detail: (a) Highlight (JsonTree.tsx:148-161) marks only the first occurrence in a string; (b) Leaf blur commits the edit (:271) — click-away while invalid leaves an orphaned red input, and blur-commit on rename (:198) can surprise; (c) CopySplit's open menu survives a target switch and then copies the NEW cell's value (component not keyed by k, Inspector.tsx:211). Fixes: highlight all occurrences; blur cancels on invalid; key CopySplit by cell.

gaps.title: Full-value fetch has no size guard
gaps.detail: Inspector.tsx:97-98 SELECTs the whole column value — a 200MB bytea/text cell arrives as one IPC string on the UI thread. Fix: fetch octet_length first; above a threshold offer 'load anyway / save to file' instead of auto-loading.

perf_risks: Inspector.tsx:146-148 — unmemoized JSON.parse + JSON.stringify(pretty) of the full cell value on every render; with 8MB jsonb every repaint costs 100s of ms
Inspector.tsx:49-51 — subscribes to whole statements/pending/maps: re-renders (and thus re-parses, see above) on every streamed row batch and every pending edit in any cell [known roadmap item]
Inspector.tsx:287-295 + :163 — JSON.parse of the entire raw draft per keystroke plus 8MB string equality for rawDirty per render; O(doc) typing violates the 16ms budget
JsonField.tsx:95-100 — [value] echo effect calls state.doc.toString() (full-doc alloc) + string compare on every keystroke round-trip
JsonTree.tsx:333-374 — no virtualization/child cap: depth<2 renders root + all direct children open; 50k-element array = 50k mounted components; long string leaves render fully inline
JsonTree.tsx:317-320 — Node registerRef useEffect has no dependency array: every visible node re-registers into the ref Map on every render (search keystroke, edit, hit-step)

JsonTree.tsx:90-134,400 — computeSearch walks all nodes per keystroke with JSON.stringify(path) ids and per-node array spreads; no debounce; recomputes fully after every staged edit (new json identity)

Inspector.tsx:120-127 — controlled 8MB textarea for scalar edit: full string state copy + scrollHeight layout read per keystroke; large plain values also render as one unvirtualized pre-wrap DOM node (:315-321)
Inspector.tsx:97-101 + inspector.ts:41 — full-value SELECT is unguarded (whole value in one IPC string), uncancelled (rapid cell-stepping stacks queries), and cached size-1 (refetch every revisit)
bytea rendering — 8MB blob = 16MB hex text through CELL_CAP/full-fetch into a single DOM text node; no binary-aware path
